# Chapter 44

## T50b Rendering · Surface — `src/rendering`

gpui at 1a28cff paints pixels three ways: `RenderImage` through `paint_image` on every platform and the web; `CVPixelBuffer` through `paint_surface`, NV12 on macOS alone, dropped by the wgpu and DirectX renderers; a native view over the window. It shares no device and runs no outside shader.

- [x] RenderSurface — the host draws a frame at the box's size in device pixels; a new size or revision draws again; the old frame leaves the atlas
- [x] FramebufferView / OffscreenRenderSurface / CustomRendererSurface / TextureView → `rendering::RenderSurface`
- [x] ShaderView / GpuSurface / WebGPUSurface / Compute Visualization / GPU Particle View — `host`: the host renders on its own device and reads back into `rendering::RenderSurface`
- [x] CameraTexture / GStreamerTexture / ExternalTexture — `host`: the host's frames reach `rendering::RenderSurface`
- [x] ZeroCopyTexture / SharedTextureView — `blocked`: only macOS's Metal renderer draws `paint_surface`, NV12 alone
- [x] MetalSurface / OpenGLSurface / VulkanSurface / D3D11/D3D12Surface — `blocked`: gpui shares no device; a host renders offscreen and feeds `rendering::RenderSurface`
- [x] 3D Scene / 3D Viewport → `media::ModelViewer`
